Dear Shareholders:
2024 was a strong year for Amazon.
Our total revenue grew 11% year-over-year (“YoY”) from $575B to $638B. By segment, North America
revenue increased 10% YoY from $353B to $387B, International revenue grew 9% YoY from $131B to $143B,
and AWS revenue increased 19% YoY, from $91B to $108B. For perspective, just 10 years ago, AWS
